QuestInfo.name: [Astra Secondary Weapon] Reason for Release
QuestInfo.0:
Erion can make you a good weapon, if only he had the materials. He'll need Vestiges of Erion and energy from formidable enemies. Better get to gathering.

#r* During the Astra Secondary Weapon quest, you can access Ereve Underground Prison via the hidden portal in Crossroads of Ereve.#k
QuestInfo.1:
Find Vestiges of Erion in Grandis and collect Traces of Battle by defeating formidable enemies. Once you have everything, deliver the materials to Erion in the prison.

#r* During the Astra Secondary Weapon quest, you can access Ereve Underground Prison via the hidden portal in Crossroads of Ereve.#k
QuestInfo.2: Erion instantly forged a powerful weapon inside the prison using the materials you gathered. This confirmed without a shadow of a doubt that Erion was the ancient god he claimed to be.

default.0: Oh, the feeling of a hammer in my hands and a perfect weapon on the anvil... Won't you let me experience it again?
